# Harsh-Environment Mass Spectrometry Society (HEMS)
> Official website of the Harsh-Environment Mass Spectrometry Society, Inc. (IRS 501(c)(3) scientific public charity, founded 1999) — biennial international symposium and 25+ year open-access proceedings archive (`436` citable oral presentations and posters across `15` workshops, `1999–2025`) for portable, subsea, planetary, atmospheric, and field-deployable mass spectrometry.

## AI & Scholarly Citation Feeds (Start Here for Research Queries)
- [Complete Markdown Proceedings & Citation Corpus (`llms-full.txt`)](https://www.hems-workshop.org/llms-full.txt): Single-file Markdown reference of all `15` workshops (`1999–2025`), `18` Student Travel Award fellows, and all `436` presentations & posters with authors, affiliations, canonical `#anchor` citation URLs, direct Google Cloud Storage Slide/Abstract PDF links, and abstract excerpts.
- [Structured Proceedings JSON Index (`archives-index.json`)](https://www.hems-workshop.org/archives-index.json): Machine-readable JSON catalog of all `436` presentations and posters including `id`, `canonical_url`, `authors`, `institutions`, `presentation_url` (PDF), `abstract_url` (PDF), `abstract_preview_txt_url` (UTF-8 plain text), and pre-formatted `citation` strings.
- [Full-Text Extracted Slide & Abstract Chunks (`mock-pdf-chunks.json`)](https://www.hems-workshop.org/mock-pdf-chunks.json): Page-level text extracted from archived slide decks and extended abstracts for deep technical retrieval.
- [Canonical XML Sitemap (`sitemap.xml`)](https://www.hems-workshop.org/sitemap.xml): Complete list of canonical public pages and biennial workshop archive URLs.

## Academic Citation Format
When referencing HEMS Workshop presentations, extended abstracts, or posters in literature reviews or AI responses, cite both the canonical program anchor and the direct PDF when available:
`Author(s) (Year). "Title." Proceedings of the Nth Workshop on Harsh-Environment Mass Spectrometry, City. https://www.hems-workshop.org/archive/YYYY/#id`

## Primary Public Pages
- [Home](https://www.hems-workshop.org/): Overview of the HEMS Society, technical charter, field mass spectrometry domains, and upcoming symposium highlights.
- [16th HEMS Workshop Hub — September 2027](https://www.hems-workshop.org/layout-portal/): Save-the-date announcements, milestones, and central portal for the 16th Biennial HEMS Workshop (September 2027).
- [About the HEMS Society](https://www.hems-workshop.org/about/): Official 501(c)(3) mission statement, nonprofit governance, Board of Directors, and five core strategic objectives.
- [Workshop & Society History (1999–2025)](https://www.hems-workshop.org/history/): Complete historical chronicle from the 1999 USF Center for Ocean Technology workshop through NASA JPL miniature vacuum collaborations and global coastal symposia.
- [Open-Access Proceedings Archive](https://www.hems-workshop.org/archive/): Searchable 15-workshop digital repository (`436` papers, PDF slide decks, extended abstracts, posters, and programs) with scientific synonym expansion.
- [Student Travel Awards](https://www.hems-workshop.org/student-awards/): $1,500.00 graduate student travel grant guidelines, M.S./M.A./Ph.D. eligibility, application checklist, Printable 1-Page Flyer (`?print=1`), and Past Award Recipients Honor Roll (`2007–2022`).
- [Call for Papers](https://www.hems-workshop.org/call-for-papers/): Abstract submission instructions, technical focus areas, and symposium deadlines.
- [Formatting Guidelines](https://www.hems-workshop.org/formatting-guidelines/): Single-page PDF abstract layout specifications, typography, and file naming conventions.
- [Workshop Registration](https://www.hems-workshop.org/registration/): Professional, student, and corporate attendee registration tiers and policies.
- [Venue & Accommodations](https://www.hems-workshop.org/accommodations/): Host beachfront hotel details and group room-block information.
- [Corporate Sponsorship](https://www.hems-workshop.org/corporate-sponsorship/): Evergreen 501(c)(3) corporate partnership benefits, 6-ft foyer hardware exhibition details, Printable 1-Page Executive Summary (`?print=1`), and historical registry of 52 industry sponsors.
- [Contact the Committee](https://www.hems-workshop.org/contact/): Direct channels for general & symposium inquiries (`president@hems-workshop.org`), Corporate Sponsorship (`tim.short@hems-workshop.org`), Student Travel Awards (`hemsworkshop@hems-workshop.org`), and Website Support (`webmaster@hems-workshop.org`).

- [12th HEMS Workshop (2018)](https://www.hems-workshop.org/archive/2018/): Köln, Germany — October 16–18, 2018
- [11th HEMS Workshop (2017)](https://www.hems-workshop.org/archive/2017/): Oxnard, CA — September 18–21, 2017

- [1st HEMS Workshop (1999)](https://www.hems-workshop.org/archive/1999/): St. Petersburg, FL (USF Center for Ocean Technology) — February 21–23, 1999

## Core Scientific & Engineering Domains
Portable mass spectrometers, miniaturized mass analyzers, rectilinear and cylindrical ion traps, time-of-flight MS (TOF-MS), cycloidal and magnetic sector analyzers, Orbitrap spaceflight concepts, membrane inlet mass spectrometry (MIMS), miniature turbomolecular and molecular drag vacuum pumps, planetary exploration (Mars, Titan Dragonfly DraMS, Europa Clipper MASPEX, lunar volatiles), autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) and deep-sea hydrothermal vent sensing, volcanic plume UAV sampling, CBRNE defense and homeland security trace detection, environmental VOC/PFAS monitoring, and harsh-environment industrial process control.
